alt: Katerina Siniakova smiles as she lifts the Osaka champion’s trophy with both hands during the 2026 Kinoshita Group Japan Open trophy ceremony. The Czech player wears a white and black tennis dress, with tournament staff and spectators in the background. A white WTA logo appears in the top-right corner.
